text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr tells me that she wants to train with Sakura Bakushin O and Nishino Flower at summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're both up-and-coming sprinters who'll be entering this year's Sprinters Stakes. I'd like for Zephyr to train with them as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take her proposal to Sakura Bakushin O and Nishino Flower, who both readily agree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr has grown so much since her debut. The aloof runner who paid no mind to those around her is gone. My summer with the new Yamanin Zephyr begins.
